sources.publisher: SBI Holdings / SBI VC Trade / Aplus / Visa Japan
sources.title: SBI VISA Crypto Card: BTC, ETH or XRP rewards with automatic monthly conversion
claims: SBI VC Trade, Aplus and Visa Japan announced the SBI VISA Crypto Card and SBI VISA Crypto Card Gold on 2026-05-01.
Each card selects one crypto asset at application from BTC, ETH or XRP.
Points earned from card spending are automatically exchanged into the selected crypto asset once per month without an exchange fee.
An SBI VC Trade VCTRADE service account is required to receive the crypto asset.
Launch terms list standard-card base reward of 0.5% and gold-card base reward of 1.0%; revolving-payment bonuses can raise the stated rates to 0.8% and 1.3%.
The gold card offers an annual benefit equal to JPY 6,600 in the selected crypto when annual card spending reaches JPY 2 million.
Using the card for SBI Securities credit-card investment accumulation can also generate crypto rewards based on monthly investment contributions.
The launch campaign offered up to 2.5% standard and 10% gold rewards for eligible May 2026 applications and spending through 2026-08-05, subject to 1,500-point and 5,000-point caps.
limitations: No cardholder count, XRP selection share, XRP reward quantity, monthly conversion amount or current active-card volume is disclosed.
The source does not identify whether reward XRP is sourced from open-market purchases, OTC, existing SBI inventory, issuer treasury or another settlement arrangement.
The launch campaign period has expired; launch promotional rates must not be presented as currently available.
The base reward terms are those published at launch; current terms require a fresh product-terms check.

sources.title: SBI Group and Visa announce the SBI VISA Crypto Card
claims: Visa's cross-post confirms the parties, selectable BTC/ETH/XRP rewards, automatic fee-free monthly conversion and SBI VC Trade account requirement.
limitations: This is a cross-post of the same joint announcement and is not independent corroboration of reward volumes or settlement execution.

sources.title: Basic agreement to explore cooperation in digital finance and payments
claims: SBI Holdings and Visa Japan signed a basic agreement to explore possible cooperation in digital finance and payments.
The announcement expressly includes potential use of digital assets, including stablecoins.
limitations: The announcement describes exploration of possible future cooperation, not a completed product launch, binding issuance mandate, XRP integration or confirmed stablecoin settlement flow.
No direct Ripple, XRP, Coinbase or Circle contractual relationship is established by this MOU.

sources.publisher: SBI Shinsei Bank / SBI VC Trade
sources.title: Yen time-deposit campaign with XRP crypto-asset exchange vouchers
claims: The campaign offered an XRP exchange voucher based on eligible six-month yen time deposits of at least JPY 300,000.
Published reward tiers ranged from JPY 500 equivalent to JPY 20,000 equivalent depending on deposit amount.
The announcement says XRP units would be calculated using the SBI VC Trade sales price at 2026-07-02 06:59 JST and vouchers would be emailed by the end of May.
limitations: The campaign announcement does not disclose total eligible deposits, vouchers issued, voucher redemptions, XRP units credited or XRP sourcing.
The July 2 reference time has passed, but actual voucher redemption and distribution remain unverified.

sources.title: SBI VC Trade begins handling Ripple USD (RLUSD)
claims: SBI VC Trade and Ripple announced that RLUSD handling on VCTRADE began after maintenance on 2026-06-24.
The announcement describes the listing as a result of the SBI Group and Ripple partnership.
limitations: RLUSD is a Ripple-issued stablecoin and is distinct from native XRP.
The listing does not disclose XRP spot purchases, XRP collateral positions, Coinbase participation or Circle USDC supply.

independence_policy.rule: SBI/Visa card cross-posts share one independence group. SBI/Visa MOU and SBI VC Trade/Ripple RLUSD listing are separate official announcements but remain company statements.
independence_policy.actual_capital: A reward program, voucher face value or card-spend percentage is not a measure of XRP spot demand. Require actual XRP credited, settlement source and executed market/OTC evidence.
independence_policy.entity_separation: SBI Holdings, SBI VC Trade, Aplus, SBI Securities, SBI Shinsei Bank and Visa are distinct legal/operating entities. Do not attribute every group product to SBI Holdings treasury or to Ripple.
